summary: The machine builds its kernel from its own sources on an ext2 root, and the kernel it built runs

cases.behavior: The machine builds its own kernel on an ext2 root with the staged TinyCC and pdpmake, the host takes the bytes it built off the disk and checks them, and GRUB starts them to a login prompt and to the debug shell, where every probe of the default suite passes, and to the debug shell of an ext2 root, where the probes of an installed root pass

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machines and removes the disk copies and the evidence, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: read the free space of the root of a copy of the os-real disk on the host, with debugfs from the ext2 volume's superblock
boot the copy and wait for the console's login prompt
log in at the console as the test account with its password
copy /src/rach2 to a workspace, build the kernel with make -f guest.mk, and hash it and set it aside in /home/test
sync the root and end the machine with QMP's quit
read the ext2 volume off the copy again and check it with e2fsck -fn
take the kernel set aside off the copy with debugfs, hash it with sha256 and check it with elfcheck
write the kernel in place of the placeholders in the candidate and recovery slots of a copy of the GRUB disk and the candidate slot of the ext2 probes' disk with mcopy, and read each back
boot the GRUB disk under SeaBIOS to the login prompt of os-simple's ext2 root, and end the machine
select the recovery entry in the menu file of the GRUB disk, boot it to the debug shell of the test image in RAM, run each probe of the list there and end the machine
boot the ext2 probes' disk under SeaBIOS to the debug shell of an ext2 root of the test manifest, run the ten probes of an installed root and end the machine

assertions.checks: the root has the 48 MiB a build needs free before the machine starts
the test account logs in at the console and its shell prompts
make -f guest.mk in a copy of /src/rach2 exits 0
the kernel the build made is at least 200000 bytes
e2fsck -fn finds nothing to repair in the volume after the synced stop
the kernel taken off the disk has the SHA-256 the guest gave it
elfcheck --kernel --tcc accepts the kernel taken off the disk
the GRUB disk's slots, and the ext2 probes' disk's for the ext2 family, read back as the kernel written there
GRUB starts the kernel the machine built to the login prompt of os-simple's ext2 root
the kernel the machine built prints its record of its clock's check at level 6 at boot
every probe of the default suite's PROBES table that the architecture builds exits 0 at the debug shell of the kernel the machine built, none killed by a signal
clockmusl prints CLOCKMUSL REFERENCE OK, its result of comparing the guest's clocks with the host's reference over UDP
the ten probes of an installed root exit 0 at the debug shell of the kernel the machine built on an ext2 root of the test manifest

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended
a build of the machine's own sources has ended
a probe has handed the debug shell back

timing.assumes: the guest's calendar clock moves by at least one second across the probe's sleep of two seconds

native.reason: the guest builds on a private copy of a disk root and the kernel it built boots from a GRUB disk that the scenario writes

cases.behavior: Root builds the staged /src/ish where it is on an ext2 root with the staged TinyCC and pdpmake, which needs the times the image gave the staged files

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine and removes the disk copy and the evidence, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: boot a copy of the os-real disk and wait for the console's login prompt
log in at the console as root with its password
run make -f guest.mk in the staged /src/ish, with no copy and no touch, and end the machine

assertions.checks: root logs in at the console and its shell prompts
make -f guest.mk in the staged /src/ish exits 0, which it cannot when the staged files have zero modification times

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended
a build of the machine's own sources has ended

native.reason: the guest builds on a private copy of a disk root
